analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. 현재 RSI는 중립 구간에서 횡보 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선되는 모습을 보이나 여전히 약세 수렴 상태를 유지하고 있어 방향성 판단이 어렵다. 거래량도 5일 평균 대비 0.49배로 위축되어 있어 추가적인 움직임을 기다린다.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for the past 3 consecutive sessions. Current RSI is hovering in neutral territory, and while the MACD histogram shows improvement, it remains in a weak convergence, making directional judgment difficult. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.49x the 5-day average, indicating a need to await further movement.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-40929.7817→-32531.3122) — 개선 중이나 여전히 음수, 약세 수렴 유지
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 1,858,200원) — 중단 부근 횡보, 밴드폭 56.50%로 넓은 편

· 스윙 저항선 (1,995,000원) — 피벗 R1(2,303,333원)이 단기 저항선 역할
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보) — 추세 전환 신호 없음
[거래량·결론]

· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) — 방향성 부재, 관망 유지 조건
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($1,581,000) vs SMA5 ($1,514,400)/SMA20 ($1,858,200)/SMA50 ($2,165,033) — Above SMA5, below SMA20/50, indicating short-term weakness and mid-term sideways movement.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($1,689,085)/SMA200 ($1,180,620) — Below SMA100, above SMA200, showing mixed mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (45.6%) + Current price level is historically in the middle range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.0→41.7) — Neutral zone sustained, no signal of trend reversal.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-40929.7817→-32531.3122) — Improving but still negative, maintaining weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $1,858,200) — Sideways movement near the middle band, with a relatively wide band width of 56.50%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($808,000) — Pivot S1 ($1,052,333) acting as short-term support.
· Swing Resistance ($1,995,000) — Pivot R1 ($2,303,333) acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways) — No signal of trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.49x) — Subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of price movements.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — Lack of directional bias, conditions for maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
analysis.patternNote: 일봉상 뚜렷한 가격 패턴은 관찰되지 않으며, 현재가는 5일 이동평균선 위에 있지만 20일 및 50일 이동평균선 아래에 위치하여 방향성 탐색 구간에 있다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: No clear price pattern is observed on the daily chart; the current price is above the 5-day moving average but below the 20-day and 50-day moving averages, indicating a phase of directional exploration.

keyPointsEn: Continuation of the 3-session consecutive wait-and-see stance.
RSI hovering in neutral zone, MACD histogram improving but maintaining weak convergence.
Reduced reliability of price movements due to subdued trading volume.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 31.8로 뚜렷한 추세가 형성되어 있으나, -DI(34.0)가 +DI(18.7)보다 높아 하락 압력이 우위에 있어 추세 전환 가능성에 유의해야 한다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: ADX at 31.8 indicates a clear trend, but the higher -DI (34.0) compared to +DI (18.7) suggests downward pressure is dominant, warranting caution for potential trend reversal.
analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판독이 이어지고 있다. 금일 RSI는 42.0에서 41.7로 소폭 하락했으나 여전히 중립 구간에 머물렀고, MACD 히스토그램은 -40929.7817에서 -32531.3122로 개선되는 모습을 보였으나 약세 수렴 상태는 유지되어, 이전 판단의 흐름을 그대로 이어간다.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see read has now held for 3 straight sessions. Today, RSI slightly decreased from 42.0 to 41.7 but remained in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram improved from -40929.7817 to -32531.3122, though the weak convergence persists, continuing the prior assessment.
